description: What are the filing deadlines for a US LLC? Give the entity type (single-member or multi-member), the formation state and the formation date to get the next federal deadline (Form 5472 + pro-forma 1120 by April 15, or Form 1065 by March 15), the $25,000 Form 5472 penalty warning, and the state's annual report/tax due date. Use for 'when is my LLC tax return due', '5472 deadline', and dormant-LLC questions.
name: compliance_deadlines
title: LLC Compliance Deadlines — IRS and state filing due dates
